# Travel Agency — Frontend (UI) Documentation

## Overview

The frontend is a React + TypeScript single-page application built with Vite and styled using Tailwind CSS. It communicates with the backend exclusively through the **MCP (Model Context Protocol)** — every action calls `POST /mcp/tools/call` instead of individual REST endpoints.

- **Framework:** React 18 + TypeScript
- **Build tool:** Vite
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS
- **HTTP client:** Axios
- **Dev server:** http://localhost:5173

---

## Project Structure

```
travel-agency-ui/
├── src/
│   ├── main.tsx                          ← App entry point
│   ├── App.tsx                           ← Root component
│   ├── index.css                         ← Global styles
│   ├── types.ts                          ← Re-exports from models
│   ├── api/
│   │   └── travelApi.ts                  ← mcpApi (MCP) + travelApi (REST)
│   ├── hooks/
│   │   └── useTravelAgency.ts            ← All state + MCP communication
│   ├── models/
│   │   ├── traveler.model.ts             ← Traveler TypeScript interfaces
│   │   └── mcp.model.ts                 ← MCP response interfaces
│   ├── pages/
│   │   └── TravelersPage.tsx             ← Main page layout
│   └── components/
│       ├── layout/
│       │   ├── Header.tsx                ← App header + refresh button
│       │   └── StatsGrid.tsx             ← Stats summary cards
│       ├── traveler/
│       │   ├── AddTravelerForm.tsx       ← Form to register a traveler
│       │   ├── SearchBar.tsx             ← Destination search input
│       │   ├── TravelersTable.tsx        ← Data table container
│       │   └── TravelerRow.tsx           ← Single table row
│       └── ui/
│           ├── Alert.tsx                 ← Success / error alert
│           ├── Badge.tsx                 ← Status badge
│           ├── Button.tsx                ← Reusable button
│           └── Input.tsx                 ← Reusable input field
```

---

## Component Tree

```
App.tsx
├── Header                  → title bar, refresh button
└── TravelersPage
    ├── Alert               → success / error messages
    ├── StatsGrid           → total travelers, destinations count
    ├── AddTravelerForm     → input form (name, email, phone, passport, destination)
    ├── SearchBar           → search by destination
    └── TravelersTable
        └── TravelerRow (× n)
```

---

## Data Flow

No component calls the server directly. All components receive data and callbacks from the `useTravelAgency` hook via props.

```
Component triggers action
        ↓
useTravelAgency hook method (addTraveler / loadTravelers / searchByDestination)
        ↓
mcpApi.callTool(toolName, arguments)
        ↓
POST /mcp/tools/call  →  Backend
        ↓
MCP JSON response
        ↓
React state updated  →  UI re-renders
```

---

## `useTravelAgency` Hook

**File:** `src/hooks/useTravelAgency.ts`

The central state manager of the entire app.

### State

| Variable | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `travelers` | `Traveler[]` | Full list of all travelers |
| `filtered` | `Traveler[]` | Currently displayed list (after search) |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Shows spinner / disables buttons |
| `error` | `string \| null` | Displayed in red Alert |
| `successMessage` | `string \| null` | Displayed in green Alert (auto-clears after 3s) |

### Methods

| Method | MCP Tool Called | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `loadTravelers()` | `list_travelers` | Fetches all travelers on mount and refresh |
| `addTraveler(dto)` | `add_traveler` | Adds new traveler, prepends to list |
| `searchByDestination(dest)` | `get_travelers_by_destination` | Filters list by destination |
| `resetSearch()` | *(no call)* | Resets filtered list back to all travelers |
| `reload()` | `list_travelers` | Same as loadTravelers, exposed for Header refresh |

---

## MCP API Client

**File:** `src/api/travelApi.ts`

```typescript
export const mcpApi = {
  listTools: async (): Promise<McpTool[]> => {
    const { data } = await http.get('/mcp/tools');
    return data.tools;
  },

  callTool: async (
    name: string,
    args: Record<string, unknown> = {},
  ): Promise<McpCallResult> => {
    const { data } = await http.post('/mcp/tools/call', {
      name,
      arguments: args,
    });
    return data;
  },
};
```

Every operation — load, add, search — goes through `callTool()`. Only `name` and `arguments` change.

---

## MCP Call Mapping

| User Action | Hook Method | Tool Name | Arguments |
|---|---|---|---|
| Page loads | `loadTravelers()` | `list_travelers` | `{}` |
| Click Refresh | `reload()` | `list_travelers` | `{}` |
| Submit Add form | `addTraveler(dto)` | `add_traveler` | `{ name, email, phone, passportNumber, destination }` |
| Type in Search | `searchByDestination(dest)` | `get_travelers_by_destination` | `{ destination }` |

---

## MCP Response Shape

```typescript
interface McpCallResult {
  content: { type: 'text'; text: string }[];  // human-readable message
  travelers?: Traveler[];                      // list/search results
  traveler?: Traveler;                         // single result after add
  total?: number;                              // count
  destination?: string;                        // echoed destination for search
}
```

- `content[0].text` → shown in the `Alert` component as success/error message
- `travelers` → bound to `filtered` state for table display
- `traveler` → prepended to `travelers` and `filtered` state after add

---

## TypeScript Models

### `Traveler` (`src/models/traveler.model.ts`)

```typescript
interface Traveler {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string;
  passportNumber: string;
  destination: string;
  createdAt: string;
}
```

### `CreateTravelerDto`

```typescript
interface CreateTravelerDto {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string;
  passportNumber: string;
  destination: string;
}
```

---

## Running the Frontend

### Prerequisites
- Node.js 18+
- Backend running on `http://localhost:3000`

### Install & Start

```bash
cd travel-agency-ui
npm install
npm run dev
```

App is available at: **http://localhost:5173**
